description: React component for a modal dialog that allows users to move a thread to a different channel in Mattermost. It includes channel selection, message preview, and error handling.

methods.name: preventActionOnPreview
methods.description: Prevents default click action and propagation on the message preview to avoid triggering other handlers.

methods.name: handlePostError
methods.description: Handles errors during post move operation, sets error state, and manages timeout for error display.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Performs the move thread operation, including moving, joining, and switching channels, with error handling.
